milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The black bed is at spawn-relative (6, 0, 7) inside the open-front oak building. The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate they've found it. max_distance=5 ensures the player actually approaches the bed (it's inside the building, so they need to enter or stand at the open north face). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the bed.

Uses inventory_has because mining birch_planks blocks drops birch_planks items into the player's inventory. The player starts with zero birch_planks in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms they successfully mined a birch_planks block from the cluster at spawn-relative (-2 to 0, 0-2, 4-7). This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a ladder places it into the player's inventory. The player starts with no ladders, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting. The crafting chain requires: mine birch_planks → craft planks into sticks (2 planks → 4 sticks, done twice) → craft 7 sticks into 3 ladders using the H-pattern on a crafting table. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.
